timeline.text: Welcome to Overstimulated After Being Around People All Day. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel overstimulated after being around people all day.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind feels crowded with noise and conversation.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I haven’t had a quiet moment in hours.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Everything feels a little too loud right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tight from being switched on all day.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to disappear into quiet for a while.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels drained from all the interaction.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I need space.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I’ve given a lot of myself today.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can give myself permission to power down.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can slowly quiet down now.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to be 'on' anymore right now.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let my senses rest.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release the tension of the day.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Quiet is allowed to be enough for a while.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I’m not antisocial, I’m simply full.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can protect this space for myself.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the noise settle.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to know what I need to recharge.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can find stillness again.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to need quiet.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can return to people when I’m ready.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can fully relax now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m restoring myself, not withdrawing from life.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be around people and still protect this need.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed this time to reset.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let myself settle.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
